items.item_text: 1. BLS from the American Red Cross or the American Heart Association.

The primary responsibility of the Hospital Assistant II is to assist technologists in the outpatient imaging centers. You will assist the technologist with patient preparation duties including but not limited to: MRI safety screening, room preparation, education and patient set up, moving patients on and off the examination tables, work-flow, stocking, obtaining supplies, and ensuring the safe and timely transport of patients. The Hospital Assistant will also assist with worklist workflow management, utilizing the Radiology Information System and the Hospital Information System (HIS) in the verification of image data archival via PACS while maintaining a clean, safe and well-stocked work environment.
